title: Mouja
overview:
An economic recovery puzzle game

Take back the money-changing puzzle coins from the evil organization, the "Moujaya Clan"! Go for it, Miketarou!

Japanese yen coins fall into the playfield in pairs. Line up coins of the same value so they touch, and once they add up to the next denomination they are exchanged for it: five 1-yen coins make a 5-yen coin, two 5-yen coins make a 10-yen coin, and so on, until two 500-yen coins become a 1,000-yen note and leave the field. Keep the field clear, because the game ends when the coins pile up to the top.

Every exchange fills the cat meter, and when it is full a cat piece drops in that upgrades every coin of the value it lands on. In versus play, chain reactions bury your opponent in nuisance cats, which you can clear with your Bomb Dog.

- Versus mode against nine computer opponents
- Endless solo mode
- Two-player battles

景気回復パズルゲーム

悪の組織“もうぢや族”から両替パズルコインを取り戻せ！！ガンバレ　ミケ太郎！！
